detail:
WHAT
Fill this week's content calendar (Mon 16 Nov – Sun 22 Nov): every post, reel and story with day, time and who makes it.

STEPS
1. Open this week's tasks on the site and list every post, reel and story.
2. Give each one a day, a posting time (8–10 PM) and an owner.
3. Add stories for the days with no post so the account never goes quiet.
4. Send it to Rashad for a look before the first post of the week.

DELIVER
The calendar for this week (sheet or Canva link) uploaded on this task.

DONE WHEN
Every item has a day, a time and an owner, and Rashad has seen it.

WHAT
Write the captions for this week's posts (Mon 16 Nov – Sun 22 Nov) and post them on time.

STEPS
1. For each post this week, write the caption in Arabic and English.
2. Add the hashtags from the brand templates.
3. Send captions + final designs to Rashad. Nothing goes out before he approves.
4. Post at the time in the content calendar (8–10 PM) and check the post looks right on the phone.

DELIVER
Captions text (one link or file for the week) uploaded on this task.

DONE WHEN
Rashad approved the captions and every post went out on its day.

WHAT
A short summary of the week (Mon 16 Nov – Sun 22 Nov) for the founders. Suhad prepares it, Rashad sends it.

STEPS
1. List what went out this week: posts, reels, stories.
2. List what is late and the new date for each.
3. Add the basic numbers from the Instagram/TikTok insights (followers, views of the top reel).
4. Send it to Rashad. Rashad sends it to the founders.

DELIVER
The summary text uploaded on this task.

DONE WHEN
Rashad has the summary by Sunday night.

WHAT
Get the Instagram and TikTok Business accounts ready before launch.

STEPS
1. Wait for Rashad to confirm the account name (handle). Do not create anything before that.
2. Switch both accounts to Business/Creator.
3. Profile photo = the logo from the brand files. Name, bio and link as Rashad approves.
4. Make the highlight covers from Jana's templates.
5. Send Rashad screenshots of both profiles.

DELIVER
Screenshots of both profiles uploaded on this task.

DONE WHEN
Rashad approved both profiles.

NOTE
Launch date depends on this. Rashad decides Mon 16 or Thu 19. Passwords: Rashad keeps them, never put them on this site.

WHAT
Make the brand templates the whole team will use: feed post, story, reel cover, highlight covers.

STEPS
1. Read the brand PDF (Roua's file) first: colours, fonts, logo rules.
2. Make the templates in Canva at 1080×1440 (feed), 1080×1920 (story / reel cover).
3. Make highlight covers for the highlights Rashad approves.
4. Put them in one shared Canva folder and share it with Suhad and Mohammed.
5. Submit the Canva link here.

DELIVER
Canva link to the templates uploaded on this task.

DONE WHEN
Suhad and Rashad approved the templates and the team can open them.

RULES (every design and video)
• Colours from the brand PDF: Blue #7C98A3, Cream #E2D9BD, black, white.
• Fonts: Impact (English), Farah (Arabic). Logo from the master file, 10% clear space, never recoloured.
• Dates and times big and easy to read.
• No AI in anything we post (no AI images, voices or video).
• Nothing off-theme: no palms, suns, flowers, balls or stars.
• Venue name and place stay hidden until Rashad says the reveal is out.

What’s coming? story week (Wed 18 – Sat 21). Stories start Wed 18 Nov.

detail:

Filming day at the venue, 4:00–5:30 PM. Film all the raw material we need at the venue.

STEPS
1. Read the plan cards for the reels of the next two weeks (📅 Plan) and make one shot list.
2. Send the shot list to Suhad the day before.
3. Charge phones/camera and empty storage. Bring a mic if you have one.
